result.markdown:
The best accounting software for a small business depends on your business size, whether you employ staff, and how much bookkeeping you want to do yourself.

**My overall recommendation is Xero**, particularly if you're running a small business in Australia. It offers a good balance of ease of use, automation, bank reconciliation, GST reporting and accountant integration.

Here are the options I'd shortlist for 2026.

## Best accounting software compared

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Excellent bank reconciliation and invoicing
- GST and BAS support
- Payroll and accountant collaboration
- Good integrations with other business apps

Best for: Most Australian small businesses.

Australian plans start around A\$37/month.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for payroll and local compliance)

- Strong Australian tax and payroll features
- BAS and GST reporting
- Good for businesses with employees
- Useful inventory and job-management options

Best for: Retail, trades and businesses with staff.

[MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks**

- Good financial reporting
- Invoicing and expense tracking
- Lots of third-party integrations
- Useful for managing business finances

Best for: Businesses wanting detailed financial reporting.

[QuickBooks Australia](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho Books**

- Good value for money
- Automated invoicing and expenses
- Useful reporting and workflow automation
- Integrates with the wider Zoho suite

Best for: Startups and smaller businesses on a budget.

[Zoho Books website](https://www.zoho.com/au/books/)

---

![FreshBooks Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RRvX6v49QkXlAnGf7iI3zuYuHq4Y5bCV2ND2uEGJjfjlSbrrgGFSfhAMTnFz47xKgD07CO5bDVnhMBo6jF3Yychs84_UW4qLs93k9PAEnaI8Kmr_xSKldMl1tHK69I4mDHX1xQ085ifzPdaKSnwyxyG_Y5668gw33P8XIfpZgJ8Lv3nST9TCXoqpEHKBFC7o?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. FreshBooks**

- Very easy to use
- Excellent invoicing and time tracking
- Good client and project management

Best for: Freelancers and consultants.

[FreshBooks website](https://www.freshbooks.com/)

These choices reflect current 2026 comparisons, with Australian GST and payroll requirements taken into account. search_results.description: The article compares small-business accounting software for 2026, emphasizing that the right platform can centralize bookkeeping, expenses, reporting, and tax tasks, while integrating with other business tools. Its top paid options include Rippling Spend for centralized expense management and workflow automation; Xero for broad features, reporting, and integrations, though its entry plan has strict limits; QuickBooks for its extensive product range and comprehensive tools; Sage Accounting for multi-user support and clear pricing; Zoho Books for automation and a free tier with revenue and user limits; Kashoo for straightforward use and multicurrency support; Wave for free accounting and invoicing, with paid support and payroll; and KashFlow for scalable, simplified online accounting. Free alternatives include ZipBooks, Money Manager Ex, GnuCash, VT Cash Book, and Adminsoft Accounts, each with different feature, platform, or support trade-offs. The article advises buyers to assess cost, scalability, reporting accuracy, support, integrations, and required features—especially payroll—before choosing. It distinguishes bookkeeping as recording daily transactions from accounting as compiling those records for financial statements and tax filing, and says its rankings reflect hands-on testing of usability, value, flexibility, and compatibility.
